purpose: Photo-first tall botanical preview workflow for PlantDex cards
allowed_ai_operations: localized cleanup of real-photo botanical assets
minor nondiagnostic repairs with written provenance
prohibited_ai_operations: generating plant silhouettes from text descriptions

stage_requirements.S00_source: Preserve exact original file and metadata hash
stage_requirements.S01_crop: Select connected flower + stem + foliage; visual crop review before isolation
stage_requirements.S02_raw_cutout: First alpha extraction from photo; technical RGBA transparency checks; defects may be repaired in S03
stage_requirements.S03_refined_cutout: REQUIRED visual: no background remnants, flower structures intact, stem connections correct, silhouette readable against dark/light backgrounds
stage_requirements.S04_upright: Deterministic rotation max 15 degrees, preserve natural anatomy; visual orientation review
stage_requirements.S05_positioned: Deterministic scale/centering entirely inside untouched original oval; visual fit review
stage_requirements.S06_gradient: Exact supplied gradient RGB via positioned alpha, zero synthetic colors; visual gradient review
stage_requirements.S07_card: Alpha composite on original back, zero changes outside plant alpha; owner approval required for production

automatic_qa: RGBA and real transparency for cutouts
full-card-size image rejected at early cutout stages
exact gradient source mapping verified per active pixel
unchanged original template bytes verified by SHA-256
final mockup reproducible from source base + preview overlay
saved image hashes and parent ancestry verified
immutable stage assets and no in-place overwrites
note: This validator cannot establish botanical correctness or detect all halo artifacts automatically; reviewers must genuinely inspect the source and cutout.
